args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, V LONG, U LONG, S TEXT(10), W LONG, R TEXT(10) NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_U_T ON T (U)
CREATE TABLE T2 (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T2 PRIMARY KEY, V LONG, U LONG, S TEXT(10), W LONG, R TEXT(10) NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_U_T2 ON T2 (U)
CREATE TABLE P (PID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_P PRIMARY KEY, Name TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE C (CID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_C PRIMARY KEY, PID LONG, Tag TEXT(10), CONSTRAINT FK_C FOREIGN KEY (PID) REFERENCES P (PID))
CREATE TABLE P2 (PID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_P2 PRIMARY KEY, Name TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE C2 (CID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_C2 PRIMARY KEY, PID LONG, Tag TEXT(10), CONSTRAINT FK_C2 FOREIGN KEY (PID) REFERENCES P2 (PID))
CREATE TABLE CP (PID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_CP PRIMARY KEY, Name TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE CC (CID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_CC PRIMARY KEY, PID LONG, Tag TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE R (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_R PRIMARY KEY, Req TEXT(10) NOT NULL, D LONG, Z TEXT(10))
UPDATE T SET V = V + 1 WHERE ID <= 2;
PARAMETERS pId Long; DELETE FROM T WHERE ID = pId;
SELECT ID, V, U, S, W, R FROM T;
SELECT ID, V, U, S, W, R FROM T WHERE V > 15;
SELECT P.PID, P.Name, C.CID, C.PID AS CPID, C.Tag FROM P INNER JOIN C ON P.PID = C.PID;
SELECT DISTINCT P.Name FROM P INNER JOIN C ON P.PID = C.PID;
